But I think he knows now that he has to recruit differently Show less Read more Like 4 Dislike ❤ by @ESPNLouisville Reply · 1 reply · Hide replies · 1 reply @ryan183 4 days ago I'm an MSU fan, but wanted to see some Louisville perspective on the game. From what I've seen, I love PKs mentality and what he says. I get it's frustrating, but this program was in the gutter only a couple years ago, sometimes you gotta give it a little time. As for the game itself, I genuinely think MSU got lucky. Louisville missed open shots. That was the game right there. I thought for being down your PG, you guys moved the ball really well, and generated some great looks. I understand being frustrated after a march madness loss, but I thought the gameplan was great, just couldn't fully execute. Best of luck to you guys in the offseason, CBB is better when Louisville is good. Show less Read more Like 5 Dislike ❤ by @ESPNLouisville Reply · 3 replies · Hide replies · 3 replies @iBxngThomas 4 days ago We need big man in 3 n D players our bigs are too soft Show less Read more Like 8 Dislike ❤ by @ESPNLouisville Reply · 1 reply · Hide replies · 1 reply @matrixsushi 4 days ago I’m trying to stay positive here. We were without the star player this team was built around, yet we stayed within a few possessions of Michigan State for most of the game—a team with a legitimate Final Four ceiling. Realistically, very few programs could contend for a championship without their top player, and we were still competitive. With Brown in the lineup (not to mention the other injuries and sickness that hit this team hard), it’s reasonable to think we would have picked up a few more wins in the regular season and ACC Tournament, earned a stronger seed, and likely made at least a Sweet 16 run. It’s frustrating, no doubt—but at the same time, it feels good to see this program back on track after the stretch we’ve been through. One more thing: it’s clear PK isn’t satisfied. You can tell he’s driven to bring a championship to Louisville, and he’s not going to stop working and learning day and night till we hang another banner.
